feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 October 2026 4:27pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 12 October 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Atlantic will drive frontal troughs across the area tonight.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, quickly veering south or southwest 5 or 6, increasing 7 or gale 8 in central areas overnight, then veering west or southwest 5 or 6 by the end of the night, occasionally 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough overnight, then mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches as well as occasional rain developing overnight. This all clearing to showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/mist/showers and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, but 6 in the east at first, backing south or southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Wednesday, increasing 6 to gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
